editorial.blurb: Swift Tavern is a bustling Wrigleyville institution where excellent service and solid American fare create the perfect pre-game or casual dining experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early before Wrigley Field events—the place fills up fast with game-goers, but the staff excels at turning tables and keeping guests happy even during chaos.

topDishes.note: great starter to kick things off
solid and satisfying, though portions vary
